program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((shape (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0))))
         (p8 (first (find-color g 8)))
         (p9 (first (find-color g 9)))
         (dr (- (first p9) (first p8)))
         (dc (- (second p9) (second p8))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (let ((nr (+ (first p) dr))
                   (nc (+ (second p) dc)))
               (if (in-bounds? nr nc (rows g) (cols g))
                   (set-cell out nr nc 3)
                   out)))
           g
           (obj-cells shape))))
